ch10 opening: Baldino's workshop, late into the night. Every bench is covered in wire.

n_baldino: Five stations. Five places where the project's old machines can still be made to talk: the mains under Citadel, the lighthouse transmitter, my mill on Zeelich, the bore on Desert Island, and Sefa's dome on the Hamalayi.
n_baldino: I built these: relays. A box, a mast, a bit of genius. Each one listens for the others, and when all five hear each other at once, the shaft's blast doors will hear them too.

n_baldino: Now the limits, because there are always limits. A relay needs power from where it stands: water pressure, wind, steam, light. No power, no voice. And they only hold the signal together for a minute. So every station needs a friend standing by.
n_baldino: You've met my test pair. Same rules out there: give them a clear line, and keep the couplers cool.
n_hero: Then we need friends at five stations, and a way to reach them all.
n_baldino: Oh, and before I forget. Take this. My pulse tool: a little thunder in a box. It jams anything with gears or wires for a few seconds. Drones, automatons, mills, doors.
n_baldino: It does nothing at all to anything alive, and it needs a few seconds to recharge. Don't wave it at mites and expect miracles.
n_baldino: The way is already here. Listen.

n_heskradio: Hesk here! I got the council's message. The glider's moored on Zeelich, by the dock. I'll fly you anywhere with a flat bit of ground. Not into the shaft, mind. She's a glider, not a mole.
pulse look lines: n_hero: The thunder box's spot on the shelf. Empty. It's in my pocket now.
